name: Daily Payment Summary column drawer exposes all default switches
description:
1. Sign in and open Daily Payment Summary.
2. Open Customize Columns.
3. Confirm each configured switch is visible and checked by default.
4. Confirm Apply is disabled until a change is made, then close the drawer.
descriptionHtml:
1. Sign in and open Daily Payment Summary.
  2. Open Customize Columns.
  3. Confirm each configured switch is visible and checked by default.
  4. Confirm Apply is disabled until a change is made, then close the drawer.
statusMessage:
AssertionError: Customize Columns does not match the default Daily Payments grid (every configurable column should be on and shown): {'Is Auto Pulled': {'switch_on': False, 'header_shown': True}}
assert not {'Is Auto Pulled': {'header_shown': True, 'switch_on': False}}
